recipes.title: Turkish Wedding Soup (Düğün Çorbası)

uniqueInstructions.text: Cut the lamb into bite-sized cubes, roll them in seasoned flour and fry.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Cut the lamb into bite-sized cubes, roll them in seasoned flour and fry.

uniqueInstructions.text: Add the lamb to the broth, bring to the boil and add the carrot, onion and seasoning. Simmer for about an hour.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Add the lamb to the broth, bring to the boil and add the carrot, onion and seasoning. Simmer for about an hour.

uniqueInstructions.text: Lift out the meat, keep back one ladleful of soup to cool, and mash the vegetables into the rest. Return the meat and keep the soup over a very low heat.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Lift out the meat, keep back one ladleful of soup to cool, and mash the vegetables into the rest. Return the meat and keep the soup over a very low heat.

uniqueInstructions.text: Beat the egg yolks with the lemon juice, then beat in the cooled ladleful of soup.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Beat the egg yolks with the lemon juice, then beat in the cooled ladleful of soup.

uniqueInstructions.text: Stir the egg mixture into the soup and heat for 2–3 minutes. Do not let it boil or the eggs will curdle.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Stir the egg mixture into the soup and heat for 2–3 minutes. Do not let it boil or the eggs will curdle.

recipes.culturalNotes: A Turkish festive soup.

recipes.title: Tunisian Fish and Barley Soup (Chorba bil Hout)
recipes.titleEn: Tunisian Fish and Barley Soup (Chorba bil Hout)

masterIngredients.name: Fish head, backbone, tail and trimmings
masterIngredients.nameEn: Fish head, backbone, tail and trimmings

masterIngredients.name: Celery leaves and stalks, coarsely chopped
masterIngredients.nameEn: Celery leaves and stalks, coarsely chopped

uniqueInstructions.text: Cover the fish head, bones and trimmings with water and bring to the boil, skimming as needed.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Cover the fish head, bones and trimmings with water and bring to the boil, skimming as needed.

uniqueInstructions.text: Boil the barley in salted water for 30 minutes, drain and keep warm.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Boil the barley in salted water for 30 minutes, drain and keep warm.

uniqueInstructions.text: Fry the fillets lightly and set them aside. Soften the onions in the same oil, add the tomato paste and stir for 2–3 minutes.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Fry the fillets lightly and set them aside. Soften the onions in the same oil, add the tomato paste and stir for 2–3 minutes.

uniqueInstructions.text: Add this to the fish stock with the garlic, cumin, coriander, paprika, parsley, celery, salt and pepper and boil for 20 minutes.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Add this to the fish stock with the garlic, cumin, coriander, paprika, parsley, celery, salt and pepper and boil for 20 minutes.

uniqueInstructions.text: Let it cool, remove the fish pieces, blend the liquid and strain it through a very fine sieve, ideally lined with muslin.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Let it cool, remove the fish pieces, blend the liquid and strain it through a very fine sieve, ideally lined with muslin.

uniqueInstructions.text: Return to the pot with the barley and fish fillets, check the seasoning and boil for 7–10 minutes, until the fish is cooked.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Return to the pot with the barley and fish fillets, check the seasoning and boil for 7–10 minutes, until the fish is cooked.

uniqueInstructions.text: Add the lemon juice and serve.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Add the lemon juice and serve.

recipes.culturalNotes: A Tunisian soup.

source.name: Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes — Samia Abdennour (AUC Press)

recipes.title: Gulf Mutton, Chickpea and Vermicelli Soup (Tchorba)
recipes.titleEn: Gulf Mutton, Chickpea and Vermicelli Soup (Tchorba)

uniqueInstructions.text: Soak the chickpeas in water overnight.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Soak the chickpeas in water overnight.

uniqueInstructions.text: Fry the cutlets in ghee, then add everything except the vermicelli, cover with twice their volume of water and cook until tender.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Fry the cutlets in ghee, then add everything except the vermicelli, cover with twice their volume of water and cook until tender.

uniqueInstructions.text: Take out the cutlets, mash the vegetables and return the cutlets to the pot.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Take out the cutlets, mash the vegetables and return the cutlets to the pot.

uniqueInstructions.text: When the soup boils, check the seasoning, add the vermicelli and cook for 10 minutes more, until it is tender and has taken on the flavour of the soup.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: When the soup boils, check the seasoning, add the vermicelli and cook for 10 minutes more, until it is tender and has taken on the flavour of the soup.

recipes.title: Tunisian Hlalem Noodle Soup with Lamb and Vegetables
recipes.titleEn: Tunisian Hlalem Noodle Soup with Lamb and Vegetables

uniqueInstructions.text: Soak the chickpeas and fava beans for a few hours. Drain, then boil with the onion in twice their volume of water for 15 minutes. Set aside with their liquid.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Soak the chickpeas and fava beans for a few hours. Drain, then boil with the onion in twice their volume of water for 15 minutes. Set aside with their liquid.

uniqueInstructions.text: Cut the lamb into bite-sized cubes and fry in olive oil. Add the scallions and garlic and cook for 5 minutes, stirring constantly.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Cut the lamb into bite-sized cubes and fry in olive oil. Add the scallions and garlic and cook for 5 minutes, stirring constantly.

uniqueInstructions.text: Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 5 minutes, then add the spinach, celery, parsley, artichokes, carrots, paprika, salt and pepper and stir until coated.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 5 minutes, then add the spinach, celery, parsley, artichokes, carrots, paprika, salt and pepper and stir until coated.

uniqueInstructions.text: Add the chickpeas and beans with their liquid and simmer for 30–45 minutes. Cool and skim off any excess fat.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Add the chickpeas and beans with their liquid and simmer for 30–45 minutes. Cool and skim off any excess fat.

uniqueInstructions.text: About an hour before serving, bring back to the boil, adding more salted water if needed, then add the hlalem and sweet peppers. Cover and simmer until the noodles are plump and soft.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: About an hour before serving, bring back to the boil, adding more salted water if needed, then add the hlalem and sweet peppers. Cover and simmer until the noodles are plump and soft.

uniqueInstructions.text: Add the peas, check the seasoning and sprinkle with fresh coriander.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Add the peas, check the seasoning and sprinkle with fresh coriander.

recipes.culturalNotes: A Tunisian soup.

recipes.title: Egyptian Chickpea Soup with Cumin and Lemon (Shurbit Hummus)
recipes.titleEn: Egyptian Chickpea Soup with Cumin and Lemon (Shurbit Hummus)

uniqueInstructions.text: Soak the chickpeas overnight and drain.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Soak the chickpeas overnight and drain.

uniqueInstructions.text: Cover with twice their volume of fresh water, add the onions and cook for 20–30 minutes, until tender.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Cover with twice their volume of fresh water, add the onions and cook for 20–30 minutes, until tender.

uniqueInstructions.text: Add the cumin, lemon juice, salt and pepper and boil for 3–5 minutes more.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Add the cumin, lemon juice, salt and pepper and boil for 3–5 minutes more.

uniqueInstructions.text: Serve with croutons of baladi bread.

recipes.titleEn: Thick Chickpea Soup over Bread (Shurbit Hummus)

uniqueInstructions.text: Soak the chickpeas overnight and drain.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Soak the chickpeas overnight and drain.

uniqueInstructions.text: Cook them with the onions in twice their volume of fresh water for 20–30 minutes. Keep back one cup of the broth.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Cook them with the onions in twice their volume of fresh water for 20–30 minutes. Keep back one cup of the broth.

uniqueInstructions.text: Add the garlic, cumin and lemon juice to the chickpeas and blend or mash into a thin paste.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Add the garlic, cumin and lemon juice to the chickpeas and blend or mash into a thin paste.

uniqueInstructions.text: Return to the heat, add the oil, season, and cook for 3–5 minutes.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Return to the heat, add the oil, season, and cook for 3–5 minutes.

uniqueInstructions.text: Cut the bread into 2–3 cm pieces and line the serving dish with them.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Cut the bread into 2–3 cm pieces and line the serving dish with them.

uniqueInstructions.text: Reheat the reserved broth, moisten the bread with it and pour the chickpea soup over.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Reheat the reserved broth, moisten the bread with it and pour the chickpea soup over.

recipes.title: Tunisian Lablabi (Garlicky Chickpea Soup over Bread)
recipes.titleEn: Tunisian Lablabi (Garlicky Chickpea Soup over Bread)

uniqueInstructions.text: Soak the chickpeas overnight and drain.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Soak the chickpeas overnight and drain.

uniqueInstructions.text: Boil them in fresh water with the onion and marrow bone until tender. Shake the marrow into the soup and mash it with the onion. Season.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Boil them in fresh water with the onion and marrow bone until tender. Shake the marrow into the soup and mash it with the onion. Season.

uniqueInstructions.text: Fry the garlic and harissa in olive oil, stirring constantly so they do not stick.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Fry the garlic and harissa in olive oil, stirring constantly so they do not stick.

uniqueInstructions.text: Add the chickpeas and broth and cook for 5 minutes. Off the heat, stir in the lemon juice and cumin.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Add the chickpeas and broth and cook for 5 minutes. Off the heat, stir in the lemon juice and cumin.

uniqueInstructions.text: Put bite-sized pieces of bread in a serving bowl, pour the soup over and serve at once.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Put bite-sized pieces of bread in a serving bowl, pour the soup over and serve at once.

recipes.titleEn: Cypriot Brown Lentil Soup with Vinegar (Fakes Xidati)

uniqueInstructions.text: Put the lentils, spring onions, garlic, oil and parsley in a large pot with twice their volume of water and boil until tender.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Put the lentils, spring onions, garlic, oil and parsley in a large pot with twice their volume of water and boil until tender.

uniqueInstructions.text: Season and keep at a gentle simmer.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Season and keep at a gentle simmer.

uniqueInstructions.text: Mix the cornflour with a tablespoon of cold water and stir it into the boiling soup to thicken it.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Mix the cornflour with a tablespoon of cold water and stir it into the boiling soup to thicken it.

uniqueInstructions.textEn: Boil in the stock for about 5 minutes, until tender.

uniqueInstructions.text: Bring the broth to the boil, add the onions and simmer for about 10 minutes.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Bring the broth to the boil, add the onions and simmer for about 10 minutes.

uniqueInstructions.text: Take off the heat and pour in the yogurt gradually, stirring constantly.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Take off the heat and pour in the yogurt gradually, stirring constantly.

uniqueInstructions.text: Return to the heat just until it reaches boiling point, then take off, add salt and sprinkle with coriander.

recipes.titleEn: Persian Yogurt Soup with Fenugreek and Walnuts (Eshkeneh Shirazi)

uniqueInstructions.textEn: Grind the fenugreek to a powder.

uniqueInstructions.text: Fry the onions until golden, add the flour and cook over a very low heat until well blended.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Fry the onions until golden, add the flour and cook over a very low heat until well blended.

uniqueInstructions.text: Add the walnuts and fenugreek with 1/2 cup of hot water and stir until smooth.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Add the walnuts and fenugreek with 1/2 cup of hot water and stir until smooth.

uniqueInstructions.text: Add 2 cups of hot water, season and simmer for 30 minutes.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Add 2 cups of hot water, season and simmer for 30 minutes.

uniqueInstructions.text: Beat a ladle of the hot soup into the yogurt, then stir the yogurt into the soup over the heat and take it off before it boils.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Beat a ladle of the hot soup into the yogurt, then stir the yogurt into the soup over the heat and take it off before it boils.

uniqueInstructions.textEn: Wilt the spinach in a pot over a low heat, then drain in a colander, pressing out all the moisture.

uniqueInstructions.textEn: Fry the onions in the olive oil until pale brown.

uniqueInstructions.textEn: Soften the onions in olive oil and spread them over the bottom of an ovenproof dish.

uniqueInstructions.textEn: Soak the chickpeas overnight and drain.

uniqueInstructions.text: Peel and slice the eggplants, salt them and leave for about an hour. Squeeze out the moisture, pat dry, deep-fry and drain on absorbent paper.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Peel and slice the eggplants, salt them and leave for about an hour. Squeeze out the moisture, pat dry, deep-fry and drain on absorbent paper.

uniqueInstructions.text: Fry the onions until dark in the same oil, then add the tomatoes, garlic and chickpeas and cook for about 20 minutes, until the chickpeas are tender, adding hot water if needed.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Fry the onions until dark in the same oil, then add the tomatoes, garlic and chickpeas and cook for about 20 minutes, until the chickpeas are tender, adding hot water if needed.

uniqueInstructions.text: Add the fried eggplant, a tablespoon each of parsley and coriander, the mint and the nutmeg or cinnamon. Season and simmer for 10 minutes more.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Add the fried eggplant, a tablespoon each of parsley and coriander, the mint and the nutmeg or cinnamon. Season and simmer for 10 minutes more.

uniqueInstructions.text: Let it cool and serve warm, topped with the rest of the herbs.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Let it cool and serve warm, topped with the rest of the herbs.

recipes.culturalNotes: Made in Lebanon, Syria and Jordan.

recipes.title: Turkish Yogurt Kebab on Toast (Yoğurtlu Kebap)
recipes.titleEn: Turkish Yogurt Kebab on Toast (Yoğurtlu Kebap)

uniqueInstructions.text: Cut the lamb into bite-sized cubes and marinate them in the onions, lemon juice and salt for at least an hour.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Cut the lamb into bite-sized cubes and marinate them in the onions, lemon juice and salt for at least an hour.

uniqueInstructions.text: Brush off the marinade and fry the lamb slowly until tender. Keep it warm.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Brush off the marinade and fry the lamb slowly until tender. Keep it warm.

uniqueInstructions.text: Sauté the tomatoes in the same oil, season and cook until the sauce thickens.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Sauté the tomatoes in the same oil, season and cook until the sauce thickens.

uniqueInstructions.text: Lay the toast in a serving dish, spread with the warm tomato sauce and top with the lamb.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Lay the toast in a serving dish, spread with the warm tomato sauce and top with the lamb.

uniqueInstructions.text: Stir the paprika, salt and pepper into the yogurt and pour it over the meat.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Stir the paprika, salt and pepper into the yogurt and pour it over the meat.

recipes.culturalNotes: A Turkish dish.

recipes.title: Zucchini with Onion and Mint (Kosa bi-l-Na‘na‘)
recipes.titleEn: Zucchini with Onion and Mint (Kosa bi-l-Na‘na‘)

uniqueInstructions.text: Peel the zucchini and slice into rounds about 2 cm thick. Slice the onions very thinly and rub them with salt.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Peel the zucchini and slice into rounds about 2 cm thick. Slice the onions very thinly and rub them with salt.

uniqueInstructions.text: Soften the onions in oil.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Soften the onions in oil.

uniqueInstructions.text: Add the zucchini and leave over a very low heat for about 20 minutes, until they have reabsorbed their own juice.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Add the zucchini and leave over a very low heat for about 20 minutes, until they have reabsorbed their own juice.

uniqueInstructions.text: Sprinkle with the mint.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Sprinkle with the mint.

recipes.title: Zucchini Simmered in Yogurt with Mint (Kosa Matbukha bi-l-Zabadi)
recipes.titleEn: Zucchini Simmered in Yogurt with Mint (Kosa Matbukha bi-l-Zabadi)

uniqueInstructions.text: Peel the zucchini and slice into rounds about 2 cm thick.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Peel the zucchini and slice into rounds about 2 cm thick.

uniqueInstructions.text: Cook them over a very low heat until they give up their juice, then drain.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Cook them over a very low heat until they give up their juice, then drain.

uniqueInstructions.text: Stir the egg white into the yogurt (it stops the yogurt curdling) and press it through a sieve over the zucchini.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Stir the egg white into the yogurt (it stops the yogurt curdling) and press it through a sieve over the zucchini.

uniqueInstructions.text: Season and cook uncovered for 15–20 minutes.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Season and cook uncovered for 15–20 minutes.

uniqueInstructions.text: Sprinkle with mint and serve hot or cold.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Sprinkle with mint and serve hot or cold.

recipes.title: Turkish Grilled Zucchini Boats with Feta and Dill (Peynirli Kabak)
recipes.titleEn: Turkish Grilled Zucchini Boats with Feta and Dill (Peynirli Kabak)

masterIngredients.name: Salt and freshly ground black pepper
masterIngredients.nameEn: Salt and freshly ground black pepper

uniqueInstructions.text: Parboil the zucchini in salted water, drain and let cool.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Parboil the zucchini in salted water, drain and let cool.

uniqueInstructions.text: Halve them lengthwise and scoop out the pulp.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Halve them lengthwise and scoop out the pulp.

uniqueInstructions.text: Mix the cheeses, flour, dill and garlic and fill the zucchini.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Mix the cheeses, flour, dill and garlic and fill the zucchini.

uniqueInstructions.text: Top each with a dot of butter, grill until golden and sprinkle with black pepper.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Top each with a dot of butter, grill until golden and sprinkle with black pepper.

recipes.title: Turkish Batter-Fried Zucchini (Kabak Kızartması)

uniqueInstructions.text: Peel and slice the zucchini.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Peel and slice the zucchini.

uniqueInstructions.text: Beat the flour, salt and beer into a smooth batter.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Beat the flour, salt and beer into a smooth batter.

uniqueInstructions.text: Dip each slice in the batter and shallow-fry in very hot oil until golden.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Dip each slice in the batter and shallow-fry in very hot oil until golden.

recipes.culturalNotes: A Turkish dish. The book’s batter uses beer; sparkling water is our suggested alcohol-free swap and gives a similarly light, crisp coating.

uniqueInstructions.text: Dissolve the sugar in the water, add the lemon rind and bring to the boil over a low heat.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Dissolve the sugar in the water, add the lemon rind and bring to the boil over a low heat.

uniqueInstructions.text: Boil for 10 minutes, stirring now and then and skimming as needed.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Boil for 10 minutes, stirring now and then and skimming as needed.

uniqueInstructions.text: Strain and let cool.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Strain and let cool.

uniqueInstructions.text: Stir in the lemon juice.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Stir in the lemon juice.

uniqueInstructions.text: Pour into an ice tray and freeze for 60–90 minutes.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Pour into an ice tray and freeze for 60–90 minutes.

masterIngredients.name: Grated rind of lemons and oranges
masterIngredients.nameEn: Grated rind of lemons and oranges

uniqueInstructions.text: Dissolve the sugar in the water, add the grated rinds and boil gently for 10 minutes, skimming as needed.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Dissolve the sugar in the water, add the grated rinds and boil gently for 10 minutes, skimming as needed.

uniqueInstructions.text: Strain and let cool.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Strain and let cool.

uniqueInstructions.text: Stir in the orange and lemon juice.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Stir in the orange and lemon juice.

uniqueInstructions.text: Pour into an ice tray and freeze for 60–90 minutes.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Pour into an ice tray and freeze for 60–90 minutes.

recipes.culturalNotes: Adjust the sugar to the oranges: with sweet (sukkari) oranges, one cup is enough.

recipes.title: Rosewater Starch Pudding (Baluza)

masterIngredients.name: Finely crushed roasted nuts mixed with sugar
masterIngredients.nameEn: Finely crushed roasted nuts mixed with sugar

uniqueInstructions.text: Mix the starch into 1 cup of cold water.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Mix the starch into 1 cup of cold water.

uniqueInstructions.text: Dissolve the sugar in the remaining water in a medium pot over a low heat.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Dissolve the sugar in the remaining water in a medium pot over a low heat.

uniqueInstructions.text: Add the starch and stir constantly until the baluza thickens like a thin custard.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Add the starch and stir constantly until the baluza thickens like a thin custard.

uniqueInstructions.text: Turn off the heat, stir in the rosewater and pour into individual bowls.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Turn off the heat, stir in the rosewater and pour into individual bowls.

uniqueInstructions.text: When cool, sprinkle with the nuts.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: When cool, sprinkle with the nuts.

recipes.culturalNotes: For sweet dishes the book mixes finely crushed roasted almonds, hazelnuts, pecans or peanuts with sugar, two parts nuts to one part sugar.

recipes.title: Baked Pumpkin with Raisins and Milk Cream (Saniyit ’Ar‘ ‘Asali)
recipes.titleEn: Baked Pumpkin with Raisins and Milk Cream (Saniyit ’Ar‘ ‘Asali)

uniqueInstructions.text: Slice the pumpkin into rounds, remove the seeds, peel and chop roughly.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Slice the pumpkin into rounds, remove the seeds, peel and chop roughly.

uniqueInstructions.text: Stew the pumpkin in its own juice over a very low heat, tossing at first and then stirring gently now and then so it does not stick.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Stew the pumpkin in its own juice over a very low heat, tossing at first and then stirring gently now and then so it does not stick.

uniqueInstructions.text: When it is very soft, tilt the pot and pour off as much juice as possible. Add the 1/4 kg sugar and keep over a very low heat until dissolved.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: When it is very soft, tilt the pot and pour off as much juice as possible. Add the 1/4 kg sugar and keep over a very low heat until dissolved.

uniqueInstructions.text: Sweet white sauce: mix the cornflour into half the cold milk, bring the rest of the milk to the boil with the teaspoon of sugar, add the cornflour mixture and cook, stirring, until like a thin custard. Stir in the rosewater.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Sweet white sauce: mix the cornflour into half the cold milk, bring the rest of the milk to the boil with the teaspoon of sugar, add the cornflour mixture and cook, stirring, until like a thin custard. Stir in the rosewater.

uniqueInstructions.text: Mash the pumpkin smooth, spread it in a baking pan and scatter over the raisins and almonds.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Mash the pumpkin smooth, spread it in a baking pan and scatter over the raisins and almonds.

uniqueInstructions.text: Cover with a thin layer of the white sauce; the pumpkin should be twice as thick as the sauce. Pour a beaten egg over the top if you like.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Cover with a thin layer of the white sauce; the pumpkin should be twice as thick as the sauce. Pour a beaten egg over the top if you like.

uniqueInstructions.text: Bake in the middle of a preheated oven until bubbling, then brown the top under the grill.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Bake in the middle of a preheated oven until bubbling, then brown the top under the grill.

recipes.culturalNotes: Choose a very hard, pale pumpkin: the harder it is, the drier and riper. The seeds are good roasted with a pinch of salt.

recipes.title: Nut-Filled Gullash Fingers in Syrup (Asabi‘ Gullash)
recipes.titleEn: Nut-Filled Gullash Fingers in Syrup (Asabi‘ Gullash)

masterIngredients.name: Finely crushed roasted nuts mixed with sugar
masterIngredients.nameEn: Finely crushed roasted nuts mixed with sugar

uniqueInstructions.text: Syrup: boil the sugar and water for 3–5 minutes, add the lemon juice and cook until slightly thickened. Let it cool completely.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Syrup: boil the sugar and water for 3–5 minutes, add the lemon juice and cook until slightly thickened. Let it cool completely.

uniqueInstructions.text: Mix the nuts with the cinnamon. Cut the gullash into 10 cm squares and keep them under a cloth.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Mix the nuts with the cinnamon. Cut the gullash into 10 cm squares and keep them under a cloth.

uniqueInstructions.text: Working one square at a time, lay a pencil-thin line of filling 1 cm from the edges, turn in the sides and roll up very tightly.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Working one square at a time, lay a pencil-thin line of filling 1 cm from the edges, turn in the sides and roll up very tightly.

uniqueInstructions.text: Pack the fingers side by side in a greased baking pan.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Pack the fingers side by side in a greased baking pan.

uniqueInstructions.text: Brush each with melted butter and bake in a moderate, preheated oven until golden.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Brush each with melted butter and bake in a moderate, preheated oven until golden.

uniqueInstructions.text: Take them out and dip them lightly in the cold syrup.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Take them out and dip them lightly in the cold syrup.

recipes.culturalNotes: The book’s rule: pour hot syrup over cold sweets, and cold syrup over hot ones.

masterIngredients.name: Water
masterIngredients.standardAmount: 1 small coffee cup (about 60 ml) per person

uniqueInstructions.text: Choose the sweetness: sada (no sugar), ‘ar-riha (just a whiff, up to 1/2 teaspoon), mazbut (as much sugar as coffee) or ziyada (twice as much sugar as coffee).
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Choose the sweetness: sada (no sugar), ‘ar-riha (just a whiff, up to 1/2 teaspoon), mazbut (as much sugar as coffee) or ziyada (twice as much sugar as coffee).

uniqueInstructions.text: Heat the water in a kanaka (small long-handled coffee pot), then add the coffee and sugar and stir.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Heat the water in a kanaka (small long-handled coffee pot), then add the coffee and sugar and stir.

uniqueInstructions.text: Take it off the heat the moment it rises and forms a layer of foam.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Take it off the heat the moment it rises and forms a layer of foam.

uniqueInstructions.text: Serve at once, pouring with a gentle shake of the hand so all the foam goes into the cup.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Serve at once, pouring with a gentle shake of the hand so all the foam goes into the cup.

uniqueInstructions.text: For several cups made in one pot, spoon the foam into the cups first so each gets a share, then pour the coffee gently down the side of each cup.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: For several cups made in one pot, spoon the foam into the cups first so each gets a share, then pour the coffee gently down the side of each cup.

uniqueInstructions.text: Mehawega (spiced) coffee (recipe 476 in the book): use coffee ground with cardamom, plus a pinch of mastic or powdered dried orange peel.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Mehawega (spiced) coffee (recipe 476 in the book): use coffee ground with cardamom, plus a pinch of mastic or powdered dried orange peel.

uniqueInstructions.text: Blend the peppers, chili, sugar and salt with 2–3 cups of water in a food processor.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Blend the peppers, chili, sugar and salt with 2–3 cups of water in a food processor.

uniqueInstructions.text: Cook in a pot over a medium heat until thick.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Cook in a pot over a medium heat until thick.

uniqueInstructions.text: Stir in the olive oil and chill overnight before using.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Stir in the olive oil and chill overnight before using.

recipes.title: Tunisian Hrous (Fermented Onion and Chili Paste)
recipes.titleEn: Tunisian Hrous (Fermented Onion and Chili Paste)

uniqueInstructions.text: Put the onions in a bowl with the turmeric and salt and leave for two days, until wet and soft. Squeeze out the moisture.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Put the onions in a bowl with the turmeric and salt and leave for two days, until wet and soft. Squeeze out the moisture.

uniqueInstructions.text: Remove the chili’s stem and seeds, chop it coarsely, soak in boiling water for 30 minutes, then drain and pat dry.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Remove the chili’s stem and seeds, chop it coarsely, soak in boiling water for 30 minutes, then drain and pat dry.

uniqueInstructions.text: Blend everything into a smooth, thick paste.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Blend everything into a smooth, thick paste.

uniqueInstructions.text: Pack into a jar, cover with a thin layer of olive oil, close and refrigerate.
uniqueInstructions.textEn: Pack into a jar, cover with a thin layer of olive oil, close and refrigerate.

uniqueInstructions.textEn: Pound everything in a mortar, or blend it, until evenly mixed.

uniqueInstructions.textEn: Keep in a tightly closed jar.
